trips.name: YUNNAN-9D7N(MUSLIM FRIENDLY)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur - Kunming (MOB): 3★ Kunming – Yingrong Hotel (Arrival day) Fly from Kuala Lumpur to Kunming. Meet and greet at Kunming Airport, then transfer to the hotel for check-in.
Day 2 Kunming - Chuxiong(B/L/D): 3★ Chuxiong – Yingrong Hotel (Full sightseeing day) Naigu Stone Forest; seasonal fruit picking; Chuxiong Yi Ancient Town.

Day 3 Chuxiong → Dali(B/L/D): 3★ Dali – Youtu Resort Hotel (Cultural dining experience) Travel to Dali after breakfast. Jeep photography tour; Huayu Ranch; Dali Ancient Town; Foreigner Street; Yunnan-style Peacock Banquet.
Day 4 Dali(B/L/D): 3★ Dali – Youtu Resort Hotel (Heritage and village culture) Donglianhua Natural Village; Weishan Ancient Town.

Day 5 Dali → Lijiang(B/L/D): 3★ Lijiang – James Joyce Coffetel (Romance Show optional; RM 260 per person, not included)                                                        Travel to Lijiang after breakfast. Baisha Ancient Town; Yuhu Village, the first village beneath the Snow Mountain; optional Lijiang Romance Show.

Day 6 Lijiang → Dali(B/L/D): 3★ Dali – Youtu Resort Hotel (Electric shuttle included at Ideal Land)                                                                                              Lijiang Ancient Town; Black Dragon Pool Park; return to Dali; Santorini–Ideal Land, including the electric shuttle service.

Day 7 Dali → Kunming(B/L): 3★ Kunming – Yingrong Hotel (Dinner on own) Travel to Kunming in the morning. Dianchi Lake scenery; Shuncheng Street; Kunming Old Street. Dinner on own to sample local snacks

Day 8 Kunming(B/L/D): (Departure transfer according to flight schedule)          Silk Museum; Luosiwan International Trade City; Dounan Flower Market. Transfer to the airport according to flight time.
Day 9 Kunming → Kuala Lumpur: (Tour ends)                                                              Board the flight from Kunming to Kuala Lumpur.

trips.name: SARAWAK HIGHLIGHTS - 4D3N (KUCHING-BAKO-ANNAH RAIS)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Kuching(_/_/D): 3★ Kuching – Hotel Accommodation (Arrival & City Heritage Day)Fly into Kuching International Airport; meet the tour guide and transfer to the hotel. Sightseeing at Kuching Waterfront, Fort Margherita, the Cat Museum, and the old town shophouses along India Street and Main Bazaar. Check in at the hotel. Welcome dinner in the evening.

Day 2 Kuching → Bako National Park → Kuching(B/L/D): 3★ Kuching – Hotel Accommodation (Rainforest & Wildlife Day) Depart by road to Kampung Bako jetty, then by boat to Bako National Park headquarters. Guided rainforest trek through mangrove and sea-stack coastline in search of the proboscis monkey and other wildlife, with free time at Telok Assam beach before the return boat and road transfer to the hotel.

Day 3 Kuching → Semenggoh → Annah Rais → Kuching(B/L/D): 3★ Kuching – Hotel Accommodation (Orangutan & Bidayuh Culture Day) Morning feeding session at Semenggoh Wildlife Centre's semi-wild orangutan sanctuary, then onward to Annah Rais Longhouse for a guided walk through the Bidayuh community, a traditional lunch, and an optional dip in the natural hot spring before returning to the hotel.

Day 4 Kuching → Kuala Lumpur: Tour Ends Check out from the hotel and enjoy free time for last-minute shopping along Main Bazaar. Transfer to Kuching International Airport for the flight back to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends with wonderful memories of Sarawak's rainforest, wildlife and Bidayuh culture.
exc: Flights
Insurance

trips.name: SHANGHAI-5D4N (MUSLIM FRIENDLY)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Shanghai → Suzhou (MOB/_/D): Suzhou – Hotel Accommodation (Arrival Day)                                                                                                                                             Gather at KLIA for check-in and flight to Shanghai, then transfer to Suzhou. Visit Jinji Lake, an open park in Suzhou with attractions such as Li's Causeway; take photos at the Oriental Gateway and Bird's Nest; and stroll and shop along Qili Shantang Street. Dinner and overnight in Suzhou. (Meals: Inflight Meal, Dinner)

Day 2 Suzhou → Hangzhou(B/L/D): Hangzhou – Hotel Accommodation (Heritage & Shopping Day)                                                                                                                                      Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Visit the World Cultural Heritage site and Couple's Retreat Garden, then shop at the Silk Factory, known for pillowcases, bedding, clothing and more. Continue to Hangzhou to visit the G20 City Balcony and shop at Sasseur Outlets for the latest clothing and handbag fashions. Overnight in Hangzhou.

Day 3 Hangzhou → Shanghai(B/L/D): Shanghai – Hotel Accommodation (City Sightseeing Day)                                                                                                                                  Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Take a boat ride on West Lake and visit the Longjing Green Tea plantation, then depart for Shanghai with a prayer stop at Pudong Mosque. Take photos at Tian An 1000 Trees, then visit The Bund for photos against the Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower. Stroll and shop along Nanjing Pedestrian Street.

Day 4 Shanghai City Tour(B/L/D): Shanghai – Hotel Accommodation (Leisure & Culture Day)                                                                                                                                                      Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the City God Temple Business Circle and Mid Lake Pavilion, then Tongrentang and the Luckin Coffee Garden Villa theme site. Continue to the mosque for prayers, then shop at AP Plaza before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Shanghai.

Day 5 Shanghai → Kuala Lumpur(B/L/MOB): Tour Ends                                                                               Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Shopping at the Florence Town Village outlet, then transfer to Shanghai Airport for the flight back to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends with wonderful memories of Suzhou, Hangzhou and Shanghai.

trips.name: JAKARTA CITY TOUR PRIVATE (MIN 5PAX)-4D3N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Jakarta (L): 3★ Jakarta – Hotel to be confirmed (Arrival day; free afternoon)                                                                                                                                                    Arrive at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) and meet your local guide. Enjoy a halal Nasi Padang welcome lunch at Pagi Sore Restaurant. Transfer to the hotel for check-in. Free afternoon to relax. Overnight in Jakarta.

Day 2 Jakarta Iconic & Historical Tour (B/L/D): 3★ Jakarta – Hotel to be confirmed (Full sightseeing day)                                                                                                     Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Monas (National Monument), including admission and the lift ride to the observation deck; photo stops at Istiqlal Mosque and Jakarta Cathedral; Zuhur prayers at Istiqlal Mosque. Enjoy Soto Betawi Haji Ma’ruf for lunch. Explore Kota Tua Batavia, featuring Fatahillah Museum, colourful bicycles and Café Batavia; shopping at Mangga Dua for clothing, prayer garments and hijabs. Dinner and return to the hotel. Overnight in Jakarta.

Day 3 Modern Jakarta & Shopping (B/L/D): 3★ Jakarta – Hotel to be confirmed (Modern city and shopping day)                                                                                                        Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Taman Mini Indonesia Indah (TMII). Enjoy lunch at Bakso Lapangan Tembak Senayan; shopping at Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia; explore M Bloc Space and Pasar Santa. Shop for souvenirs such as batik, crackers and dodol at Krisna Oleh-Oleh / Pasar Baru. Dinner and overnight in Jakarta.

Day 4 Jakarta → Kuala Lumpur (B): (Departure transfer according to flight schedule; tour ends)                                                                                                                                           Breakfast at the hotel and check out. If flight timing permits, stop at Tanah Abang for last-minute shopping. Transfer to Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) for your return flight to Kuala Lumpur.

trips.name: SEOUL KOREA-6D4N(MUSLIM FRIENDLY)
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Incheon (MOB): Incheon Hotel (Arrival Day) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Seoul (Incheon). Upon arrival at Incheon International Airport, transfer to the hotel and overnight in Incheon.

Day 2 Incheon → Nami Island → Garden of Morning Calm → Seoul (B/L/D): Seoul Hotel (Nami Island & Seasonal Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Travel to Chuncheon; take a ferry to Nami Island, famous as a filming location for Winter Sonata; visit Garden of Morning Calm (March–November). During winter (December–February), enjoy a snow experience at the Ski Resort. Dinner and overnight in Seoul. Winter Ski Activity: Ski equipment and ski wear are not included (USD 50 per person).

Day 3 Seoul City Tour (B/L/D): Seoul Hotel (Palace, Shopping & Seoul Highlights) Breakfast at hotel. Cosmetic Outlet; Gyeongbokgung Palace, a historic royal palace from the Joseon Dynasty; free time for shopping at Myeongdong Shopping Street and Namdaemun Shopping Street; visit N Seoul Tower by EV bus (Observatory entrance not included). Dinner, check in and overnight in Seoul. Optional: Hanbok rental at Gyeongbokgung Palace (approximately KRW 20,000 per person).

Day 4 Seoul Free & Easy (B): Seoul Hotel (Free & Easy Day) Breakfast at hotel. Free time to explore Seoul at your own leisure and overnight in Seoul. Optional Tour: From USD 130 per person (minimum 15 persons), including lunch, dinner, tour guide, tipping and Everland Theme Park entrance ticket. Hongdae Shopping Street.

Day 5 Seoul City Tour → Shopping → Incheon Airport (B/L/D): (Seoul City & Shopping Tour) Breakfast at hotel. Red Pine Gallery; visit Itaewon Mosque for prayer and explore Itaewon Shopping Street; Starfield Library at COEX Mall, featuring impressive 13-metre-high bookshelves. Dinner and transfer to Incheon International Airport.
Day 6 Incheon → Kuala Lumpur (MOB): (Departure Day) Board the flight from Incheon to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: BANGKOK KANCHANABURI-5D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Bangkok (MOB/L/D): Bangkok Hotel (Arrival & Bangkok Night Tour) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Bangkok. Upon arrival, lunch; visit Bee Farm; explore Bangkok Night Market. Dinner and overnight in Bangkok.

Day 2 Bangkok → Samut Songkhram → Kanchanaburi (B/L/D): Kanchanaburi Hotel (Markets & Floating Market Experience) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Shopping at Dried Food Market; travel to Samut Songkhram; Maeklong Railway Market; boat ride at Damnoen Saduak Floating Market; continue to Kanchanaburi; stop at Meena Cafe; shopping and sightseeing at JJ Market Kanchanaburi. Dinner and overnight in Kanchanaburi.

Day 3 Kanchanaburi (B/L/D): Kanchanaburi Hotel (Heritage, Railway & City Highlights) Breakfast at hotel. Mallika R.E. 124 Heritage Town with the opportunity to try traditional Thai costumes; experience a classic train ride along the Death Railway; Kanchanaburi Skywalk; photo stop at River Kwai Bridge. Return to hotel and overnight in Kanchanaburi.

Day 4 Kanchanaburi → Bangkok (B/L/D): Bangkok Hotel (Safari & Shopping Tour) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Visit Kanchanaburi Safari Park (Safari Bus included); return to Bangkok; shopping at Gems Gallery, Platinum Mall and Tofu Market. Return to hotel and overnight in Bangkok.

Day 5 Bangkok → Kuala Lumpur (B/L/MOB): (Shopping & Departure Transfer) Check out from hotel. Visit Erawadee Herb; shopping at Siam Premium Outlets Bangkok; transfer to Bangkok Airport and board the flight to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: BEIJING & INNER MONGOLIA-6D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Beijing (MOB): (Departure Day) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing Daxing International Airport (PKX).

Day 2 Beijing → Hohhot → Xilamuren Grassland (L/D): Xilamuren Yurt (Mongolian Cultural Experience) Arrive at Beijing Daxing International Airport; take the high-speed train to Hohhot, the capital of Inner Mongolia (approximately 2.5 hours); continue to Xilamuren Grassland; visit a local Mongolian family and Aobao Hill to experience the local culture and traditions; enjoy a Campfire Party in the evening. Overnight in a traditional Yurt.

Day 3 Xilamuren Grassland → Hohhot (B/L/D): Hohhot Hotel (Culture, Mosque & Muslim Street) Breakfast and check out from the Yurt. Inner Mongolia Museum; photo stop at the Tomb of Wang Zhaojun; visit the Great Mosque; explore and shop at Kuan Xiangzi Muslim Street Food; sightseeing and souvenir shopping at Saishang Laojie Street. Check in and overnight in Hohhot.

Day 4 Hohhot → Kubuqi Desert → Hohhot (B/L/D): Hohhot Hotel (Desert Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Travel to Kubuqi Desert to enjoy the desert scenery and various optional activities (optional activities not included). After dinner, return to Hohhot and overnight at hotel.

Day 5 Hohhot → Beijing City Tour (B/L/D): Beijing Hotel (Shopping & Night View) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Take the high-speed Bullet Train back to Beijing; shopping at Hongqiao Market for souvenirs, clothing and local products; enjoy the beautiful evening scenery at Landmark River. Return to hotel and overnight in Beijing.
Day 6 Beijing → Kuala Lumpur (MOB): (Departure Transfer According to Flight Schedule) Check out from hotel and transfer to Beijing Airport. Board the flight from Beijing to Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: CHENGDU, JIUZHAI & HUALONG-6D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Chengdu (MOB): (Departure Day) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Chengdu.

Day 2 Chengdu → Jiuzhaigou (B/L/D): Jiuzhaigou Hotel (Scenic Journey & Ancient City) Arrive at Chengdu Tianfu International Airport; rest and check in at the hotel in Chengdu. Breakfast, check out and depart for Jiuzhaigou while enjoying the scenic views along the journey; stop at Diexi Lake for panoramic views of the lake and mountains; visit Mao County Mosque for prayer and rest; Songpan Ancient City, featuring traditional Chinese architecture and historical surroundings (City Wall access not included). Check in and overnight in Jiuzhaigou.

Day 3 Jiuzhaigou (B/L/D): Jiuzhaigou Hotel (Full-Day Jiuzhaigou Scenic Area) Breakfast at hotel. Explore Jiuzhaigou Scenic Area, famous for its crystal-clear blue lakes, waterfalls and breathtaking natural scenery (eco-friendly shuttle vehicle ticket included). Packed halal lunch provided. Return to hotel and overnight in Jiuzhaigou.

Day 4 Jiuzhaigou → Huanglong → Maoxian (B/L/D): Maoxian Hotel (Huanglong Scenic Experience) Breakfast and check out from hotel. Visit Songzhou Mosque; explore Huanglong Scenic Area, renowned for its colourful natural pools and spectacular mountain scenery (Cable Car and Battery Car included). Continue to Maoxian; check in and overnight in Maoxian.

Day 5 Maoxian → Chengdu (B/L/D): (Panda, Shopping & Departure Transfer) Breakfast and check out from hotel; return to Chengdu. Visit Dujiangyan Panda Valley to see giant pandas; sightseeing and shopping at Chunxi Road and IFS Taikoo Li; prayer stop at Imperial City Mosque. Transfer to Chengdu Tianfu International Airport for the return flight to Kuala Lumpur.
Day 6 Chengdu → Kuala Lumpur (MOB): (Arrival Day) Board the flight from Chengdu to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: KUNMING, DALI & LIJIANG-7D5N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Kunming (MOB): (Departure Day) Gather at Kuala Lumpur International Airport 1 (KLIA 1) for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Kunming.

Day 2 Kunming → Shilin → Dali (B/L/D): Dali Hotel (Stone Forest & Ancient Town) Arrive at Kunming International Airport and check in at the hotel. Breakfast and check out; visit Naigu Stone Forest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its unique limestone formations; lunch; take the high-speed train to Dali; explore Dali Ancient Town and Foreigner Street, known for traditional architecture and unique shops. Overnight in Dali.

Day 3 Dali → Weishan → Lijiang (B/L/D): Lijiang Hotel (Heritage & Muslim Culture) Breakfast. Visit Weishan Ancient City, known for its Ming Dynasty architecture; Donglianhua Mosque, a unique Islamic heritage landmark; continue to Lijiang, a UNESCO World Heritage ancient city; explore Lijiang Ancient Town and the lively Sifang Street. Overnight in Lijiang.

Day 4 Lijiang (B/L/D): Lijiang Hotel (Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Experience – Packed Lunch) Breakfast. Explore Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Glacier Park (shuttle bus and cable car to Spruce Meadow included); enjoy the Impression Lijiang Song and Dance Show against the spectacular mountain backdrop; visit Baishui River and Blue Moon Valley; stop at Lijiang Mosque and the scenic Black Dragon Pool. Overnight in Lijiang.

Day 5 Lijiang → Kunming (B/L/D): Kunming Hotel (High-Speed Train & Shopping) Breakfast and check out. Take the high-speed train back to Kunming; visit Nanping Pedestrian Street for sightseeing and shopping; stop at Shuncheng Mosque, one of the oldest mosques in Kunming. Overnight in Kunming.

Day 6 Kunming (B/L/D): (Shopping & Departure Transfer) Breakfast and check out. Visit Yunfang Dashanghui, a popular modern shopping centre; visit Yongning Mosque, known for its historical significance; transfer to Kunming International Airport for the return flight.
Day 7 Kunming → Kuala Lumpur: (Tour Ends) Board the return flight from Kunming and arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: BEIJING HARBIN SNOW VILLAGE
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Beijing → Harbin (MOB/L/D): Harbin Hotel (Beijing City Tour & High-Speed Train) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing; arrive at Beijing Daxing International Airport; visit Tiananmen Square and Qianmen Street; transfer to the railway station and take the high-speed train to Harbin; meet and greet by the local Harbin tour guide; stop at Northeast Cotton Clothes Store; check in and overnight in Harbin.

Day 2 Harbin → Yabuli → Snow Village (B/-/-): Snow Village Accommodation (Winter & Snow Experience) Breakfast and check out. Depart for Yabuli; enjoy a horse-drawn sleigh experience; visit Snow Town Village (entrance ticket and shuttle bus included); stroll along Snow Charm Street; enjoy the scenery from the wooden walkway and Bangchui Mountain; free time to explore Snow Town. Check in and overnight in Snow Town. Optional Activity: Skiing at Ski Resort – approximately RMB300 per person.

Day 3 Snow Village → Harbin (B/-/D): Harbin Hotel (Snow Village & Harbin City Tour) Breakfast and check out. Visit Snow Town Stone Monument; return to Harbin; stroll along Central Street; visit Sophia Cathedral Square. Check in and overnight in Harbin.

Day 4 Harbin → Volga Estate → Harbin (B/L/D): Harbin Hotel (Volga Estate & Ice and Snow World) Breakfast at hotel. Visit Volga Estate; St. Nicholas Church; Vodka Castle; Petrov Art Palace; experience the spectacular Ice and Snow World. Return to hotel and overnight in Harbin.

Day 5 Harbin → Beijing (B/L/D): Beijing Hotel (High-Speed Train & Shopping) Breakfast and check out. Take the high-speed train back to Beijing; visit Xiushui Street; shopping at Hongqiao Market. Check in and overnight in Beijing.
Day 6 Beijing → Kuala Lumpur (B/MOB): (Departure Day) Breakfast and check out. Transfer to the airport for the return flight to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.

trips.name: BEIJING HARBIN YABULI-5D4N
itin: Day 1 Kuala Lumpur → Beijing → Harbin (-/L/D): Harbin Hotel (Arrival & High-Speed Train) Gather at KLIA for check-in and board the flight from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing; arrive at Beijing Daxing International Airport; transfer to the railway station and take the high-speed train to Harbin; packed lunch provided; photo stop at the famous Giant Snowman. Check in and overnight in Harbin.

Day 2 Harbin → Yabuli → Harbin (B/L/D): Harbin Hotel (Yabuli Winter Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Depart for Yabuli and enjoy a Horse-Drawn Sledge Ride; return to Harbin; dinner. Return to hotel and overnight in Harbin.

Day 3 Harbin (B/L/D): Harbin Hotel (Harbin City & Ice Experience) Breakfast at hotel. Visit Daowai Mosque; stroll along Central Street; photo stop at Saint Sophia Cathedral Square; visit Harbin Ice & Snow World; dinner. Return to hotel and overnight in Harbin.

Day 4 Harbin → Beijing (B/L/D): Beijing Hotel (High-Speed Train & Shopping) Breakfast and check out. Transfer to the railway station and take the high-speed train to Beijing; packed lunch provided; stroll along Qianmen Street; shopping at Hongqiao Market; dinner. Check in and overnight in Beijing.
Day 5 Beijing → Kuala Lumpur (B/MOB): (Departure Day) Breakfast and check out. Transfer to the airport for the return flight to Kuala Lumpur. Arrive in Kuala Lumpur. Tour ends.
